data.name: Aleezah
data.gender_notes: Aleezah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is submissive to Allah and obeys His commands. The name Aleezah carries the meaning “Submission to Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aleezah usually hope their child will grow to embody submission to allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name derived from the word 'Izah' meaning 'submission', evoking a sense of devotion and surrender to God.
data.etymology: Aleezah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Submission to Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aleezah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: عليزة
in_arabic.meaning: عليزة تعني الرفعة و العلو في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عليزة مشتق من الجذر العربي (ع ل ز) الذي يعني الرفعة و العلو. يستخدم الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية ليعبر عن المكانة العالية و الشرف. وردت مشتقات هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم، مما يعطي الاسم قيمة دينية و روحانية.

in_urdu.name: علیزہ
in_urdu.meaning: علیزہ کا مطلب ہے رفعت اور علو در مقام
in_urdu.long_meaning: علیزہ نام عربی جڑ (ع ل ز) سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے رفعت اور علو در مقام۔ جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان یہ نام اعلیٰ مقام اور شرافت کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ اس جڑ کے مشتقات قرآن کریم میں پائے جاتے ہیں، جو اس نام کو ایک خاص دینی اور روحانی اہمیت دیتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अलीज़ा
in_hindi.meaning: अलीज़ा का अर्थ है उच्च स्थान और सम्मान
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलीज़ा नाम अरबी मूल (ع ل ز) से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है उच्च स्थान और सम्मान। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम उच्च दर्जा और प्रतिष्ठा के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है। इस जड़ के व्युत्पन्न कुरआन में पाए जाते हैं, जो इस नाम को एक विशेष धार्मिक और आध्यात्मिक महत्व प्रदान करते हैं।

in_pashto.name: عليزه
in_pashto.meaning: عليزه د لوړ مقام او درناوي معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: عليزه نوم د عربي ريښې (ع ل ز) څخه اخيستل شوی دی چې د لوړ مقام او درناوي معنی لري. په افغانستان او پښتونستان کې دا نوم د لوړ مقام او شرافت د څرګندولو لپاره کارول کیږي. د دې ريښې مشتقات په قرآن کريم کې موندل شوي، چې دا نوم ته خاصه دينی او روحاني ارزښت ورکوي.

in_english.name: Aleezah
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aleezah originates from the Arabic root (ع ل ز), signifying exaltation, elevation, and nobility. It is used in Islamic culture to denote high status and honor. Derivatives of this root appear in the Quran, lending the name a religious and spiritual significance. Aleezah symbolizes a person of high moral character and dignity.

This particular name holds significant reverence as it highlights the importance of obedience, piety, and faith in Muslim society. The name "Aleezah" indirectly echoes the values of Islamic teachings and provides a strong reminder of one's religious responsibilities.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Aleezah" carries profound spiritual significance as it symbolizes the inner surrender and devotion towards Allah. By looking at the meaning behind the name, one can gain a deeper understanding of the importance of following the divine guidance and living a righteous life. For Muslims, the name "Aleezah" serves as a constant reminder of their spiritual journey and their ultimate goal of achieving nearness to Allah. It encourages individuals to strive for a deeper connection with their Creator and to continually seek His pleasure in every aspect of their lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Submission to Allah" symbolizes The one who is submissive to Allah and obeys His commands. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Aleezah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of submission to allah.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Aleezah bint Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (614-682 CE) The name Aleezah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Daughter of Abu Bakr As-Siddiq, the first caliph of Islam, and wife of Umar ibn Al-Khattab, the second caliph of Islam.

trends: Classic Islamic name maintaining steady popularity
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Aleezah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
